snippet.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved | New Missions Trailer | XBOX Games Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Before the events of Halo: Combat Evolved, the Master Chief and Sgt Johnson take part in Operation: Meteorite, in which they infiltrate a mysterious Covenant ship on a clandestine assignment. Experience their fight behind enemy lines in the form of three all-new bonus missions included in Halo: Campaign Evolved.

Halo: Campaign Evolved is coming to XBOX on July 28. Pre-order the Premium or Collector’s Edition and get up to 5 days early access beginning July 23, 2026.

Pre-order now: https://www.xbox.com/games/halo-campaign-evolved  

Halo: Campaign Evolved is coming to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC as an XBOX Play Anywhere title and with XBOX Game Pass.
